dog.description_text:
Hi! My name is Ampert! 🐾❤️

I’m about a year old, and I made the big trip all the way from Georgia to find my forever home!

A few things you should know about me:

- I’m a very sweet, loving, and silly boy!
- I LOVE looking at myself in the mirror. I guess I’m a little bit of a heartthrob! 😉
- I’m a quiet gentleman — I don’t bark!
- I love my daytime naps. I’m always down for a good snooze and a cozy place to cuddle up!
- I love being around people and making everyone smile.
- I’m full of personality and have so much love to give!
- I am trained in my crate and make no peep!
- I learned how to sit in less than 24 hours too!

I’m just a happy guy looking for a family to call my own. All I need is someone to love me as much as I’ll love them.
dog.name: Ampert
